parsed_output.reasoning_summary: This arm is an explicit placebo: an off-topic expository text about sourdough fermentation, structurally equivalent to the control fillers (neckties, baseball, dance) in length, tone, and irrelevance to climate. There is no messenger, no counter-attitudinal evidence, no climate or trust-in-science content, so no persuasive mechanism targets any outcome. The only conceivable spillover is a faint priming of appreciation for microbiology/science and for knowledge accumulated over millennia ('humans managed without fully understanding it'), which could nudge general science-warmth by a fraction of a point at most — well within sampling noise. I therefore forecast essentially zero ATEs, with the tiniest positive tilt on the fresh multidimensional trust battery and scientist-role items (which lack pre-treatment anchoring and thus are marginally more susceptible to mood/priming), and near-exact zeros on belief, concern, policy, intentions, and the two incentivized behaviors. Signs are kept internally consistent (a hair of extra trust implies a hair less distrust), but magnitudes are all under ~0.2 points, $0.01, and 0.3 percentage points.
